GameDetailsViewModelTests.Rail_marks_sit.reason: This method asserts the obsolete GameDetailsViewModel RailMarks/GapCaption model. Neither the baseline desktop GameDetailsView.axaml nor fullscreen Details/History pages bind those properties. Current design-system section10.2 and both active views use the activity timeline: calendar/tracked geometry and clustered update marks without a14-mark cap. Electron tests derive unread state from last play plus release watermarks and keep every clustered update selectable. The old normalized gap positions, caption strings and14-mark truncation are not active behavior to reproduce.
